data: Which of the following bins has the tallest purple bar in the right graph?

The question asks which bin has the tallest purple bar in the right graph. The right graph shows the length distribution of answers in the training set. The bars represent the count of answers for each token length range. The tallest purple bar appears in the bin around 25 tokens. Therefore, the bin with the tallest purple bar is the one corresponding to approximately 25 tokens.
